lowering_path.summary: Triton-Ascend constructs and runs the TTIR adapter before AscendNPU-IR compilation.
HFusion pipeline construction is source-visible, but does not by itself assign an original Triton operation to one pipe.
The bishengir compiler pass sequence is source-visible.
HIVM exposes single-pipe, macro input/output-pipe, and unassigned operations; this interface does not make every source Triton operation single-pipe.

mappings.reason: CopyOp with UB source and UB destination returns PIPE_V. The profiler display-name correspondence is an enum-name inference.
CopyOp with L0C source and GM destination returns PIPE_FIX. The profiler display-name correspondence is an enum-name inference.
CopyOp with GM source and L1 destination returns PIPE_MTE2. The profiler display-name correspondence is an enum-name inference.
VBrc with an L1 destination returns PIPE_MTE2. The profiler display-name correspondence is an enum-name inference.
VBrc with a UB destination returns PIPE_V. The profiler display-name correspondence is an enum-name inference.

mappings.why_unknown: A general Triton load may lower through layout- and address-space-dependent operations; the reviewed source does not establish one pipe.
mappings.next_evidence: Capture a single-purpose load microbenchmark through TTIR/adapter/HIVM and correlate the emitted operation with compact profiler evidence.

mappings.why_unknown: A general Triton store is destination- and lowering-dependent; it is not proven equivalent to a specific HIVM CopyOp case.
mappings.next_evidence: Capture a single-purpose store microbenchmark through TTIR/adapter/HIVM and correlate it with compact profiler evidence.

mappings.why_unknown: The reviewed scheduling interface allows macro and unassigned operations and does not prove an original tl.dot has exactly one pipe.
mappings.next_evidence: Capture a dot-only microbenchmark and inspect both the emitted HIVM operations and profiler pipe evidence.

mappings.why_unknown: Elementwise is a source-level family, not one reviewed lowered operation.
mappings.next_evidence: Use separate arithmetic microbenchmarks and correlate their HIVM instructions with profiler evidence.

mappings.why_unknown: Reduction lowering and synchronization are not assigned to a single pipe by the reviewed evidence.
mappings.next_evidence: Capture a reduction-only microbenchmark and inspect the complete emitted sequence before correlating profiler evidence.

mappings.why_unknown: The compiler pass sequence is known, but a layout conversion may be folded or expanded and has no proven single execution pipe.
mappings.next_evidence: Compare otherwise identical microbenchmarks with and without the layout conversion and inspect emitted HIVM.

mappings.why_unknown: No reviewed source establishes synchronization as a profiler-visible single-pipe operation.
mappings.next_evidence: Inspect a synchronization-containing HIVM sequence and correlate timeline gaps rather than assuming a pipe.
